title: 第23章 奖励第24章 七王爷
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
在这股威势的加持下，圣女竟然能够与那只遮天蔽日的巨掌呈现分庭抗礼之势。
她的身影在空中快速穿梭，双手不断挥动，释放出一道道毒芒，试图打破巨掌的束缚。
“嗯？七转化神蝎，老毒物竟然连这种东西都给你了，看来对你是寄予厚望啊，就是不知道若是你陨落在此，他会做何感想？”
天空之中，那威严的声音再次响起，带着一丝玩味。
随着话语落下，那只遮天蔽日的巨掌威势更盛三分，其上流转的金色光芒愈发耀眼，仿若将天地间的伟力都凝聚于一身，展现出一种不可抗拒的碾压之势。
五毒教圣女脸色惨白，她万万没想到，自己拼尽全力，竟然还是无法抵挡这巨掌的一击。
她感受到那股如山岳般沉重的压力，仿佛要将她的身体、她的灵魂都彻底碾压成粉末。
“噗！”
随着一声沉闷的声响，五毒教圣女终于无法承受这股压力，直接喷出一口鲜血，她的身体也在这股巨力的压迫下，不由自主地弯下了腰。
在她惊恐的目光之中，那只巨掌如同天神降临般，结结实实地压了下来。
她能够清晰地感受到那股死亡的气息正在迅速逼近，她想要挣扎，想要逃避，但一切都已经来不及了。
“轰！”
随着一声震耳欲聋的巨响，这座名为煤山的小山山头直接被夷为平地，尘土飞扬，碎石四溅。
巨掌之下，仿佛连空间都被彻底撕裂开来，形成了一道道触目惊心的裂缝。
而在这毁灭性的一击之下，五毒教圣女与王斯年两人则是如同蝼蚁般渺小，被这只巨掌毫不留情地抓在手中。
他们的身体在这股巨力的挤压下，几乎要被彻底摧毁。
片刻之后，当一切归于平静，煤山之上已经再也看不到两人的身影。
他们仿佛被这股力量彻底吞噬了一般，消失在了原地。
只留下那满地的碎石与尘土，以及空气中弥漫着的浓郁血腥味。
……

“砰！”
一声清脆的声响，一根细长的金针稳稳地插入了坚硬的砖石之中，针尖处所蕴含的剧毒迅速蔓延，让接触到的石头表面都泛起了几分诡异的黑色。
“好毒，扎石头都这么厉害，要是用来扎人那还了得？”
江辰轻轻摇了摇头，嘴角勾起一抹满意的笑容。
他缓缓拔出那枚金针，仔细端详着其上残留的黑色痕迹，眼中闪过一丝赞叹。
随后，他伸了个懒腰，仿佛将一夜的疲惫都抛诸脑后，取下挂在墙上那把寒光闪闪的血刀，大步流星地向门外走去。
阳光洒在他的身上，为他披上了一层金色的光辉。
江辰很快便来到了锦衣卫的驻地。
刚一进门，众多锦衣卫的目光便齐刷刷地投向他，那目光中夹杂着各种复杂的情绪。
或羡慕，或嫉妒，或敬畏。
江辰心中也清楚，这些目光的源头，正是因为他昨天成功破获了玉灵公主失踪案。
这个案子不仅让朝廷上下为之震动，也让江辰的名字在锦衣卫，甚至是京城中迅速传开，成为了一个传奇般的存在。
孟望津看着他，脸色显得颇为复杂。
片刻之后，他被孟望津叫进了自己办公的地方。
content_en:
With the blessing of this power, the saint was able to compete with that giant palm that covered the sky and the sun.
Her figure quickly shuttled through the air, waving her hands continuously, releasing streaks of poisonous light, trying to break the shackles of the giant palm.
"Huh? The Seven-Transformation Divine Scorpion, Old Poison even gave you such a thing. It seems that he has high hopes for you. I just wonder what he would think if you died here?"
In the sky, the majestic voice sounded again, with a hint of amusement.
As the words fell, the power of the giant palm that covered the sky and the sun became even more powerful, and the golden light flowing on it became more and more dazzling, as if the great power of heaven and earth were condensed into one body, showing an irresistible crushing force.
The Saintess of the Five Poison Sect's face turned pale. She never expected that even though she tried her best, she still couldn't resist the blow of this giant palm.
She felt the pressure as heavy as a mountain, as if it was going to completely crush her body and soul into powder.
"Poof!"
With a dull sound, the Saint of the Five Poisons finally could not bear the pressure and spurted out a mouthful of blood. Her body also involuntarily bent down under the pressure of this huge force.
In her horrified gaze, the giant palm pressed down firmly as if a god had descended.
She could clearly feel the breath of death approaching quickly. She wanted to struggle and escape, but it was too late.
"Boom!"
With a deafening loud noise, the top of the hill called Meishan was directly flattened to the ground, with dust flying and gravel flying everywhere.
Under the giant palm, it seemed that even the space was completely torn apart, forming shocking cracks.
Under this devastating blow, the Holy Maiden of the Five Poison Sect and Wang Sinian were as small as ants, and were mercilessly grasped by this giant hand.
Their bodies were almost completely destroyed under the squeeze of this huge force.
After a while, when everything returned to calm, the two people could no longer be seen on the coal mountain.
They seemed to be completely swallowed up by this force and disappeared in place.
Only the gravel and dust on the ground were left, as well as the strong smell of blood filling the air.
…
"Bang!"
With a crisp sound, a slender golden needle was stably inserted into the hard masonry. The poison contained in the needle tip spread quickly, making the surface of the stone it came into contact with a strange black color.
"It's so poisonous. It's so powerful when it stings stones. How can it be used to sting people?"
Jiang Chen shook his head gently, with a satisfied smile on his lips.
He slowly pulled out the golden needle and carefully examined the remaining black traces on it, a hint of admiration flashing in his eyes.
Then, he stretched out, as if he had left all the fatigue of the night behind, took off the gleaming bloody knife hanging on the wall, and strode out the door with quick strides.
The sun shone on his body, covering him with a golden glow.
Jiang Chen soon arrived at Jinyiwei's station.
As soon as he entered the door, the eyes of many Jin Yiwei were directed at him, and their eyes were mixed with various complex emotions.
Either envy, jealousy, or awe.
Jiang Chen also knew in his heart that the source of these glances was precisely because he successfully solved the disappearance case of Princess Yuling yesterday.
This case not only shocked the entire court, but also caused Jiang Chen's name to quickly spread among the Jinyi Guards and even the capital, becoming a legendary existence.
Meng Wangjin looked at him with a complicated expression.
After a while, he was called into his office by Meng Wangjin.
